full_judgment: 35. The appellant claims to have been in possession of the remaining properties measuring 7.5I acres and appertaining to Khatians No.20, 53, 760 936, 1006, 1023, 1024, 107, 1441 land 1555 of Mousa Birampur as a co-sharer. The records of rights with regard to these Khatians have been filed with the supplementary affidavit of the appellant as Annexure ‘F’ series. Of these Khatians, Khatian No.1006 appellant and therefore it cannot be regarded as enemy property in any way. The lands of Khatians No.1441 and 1555 have been recorded in the names of persons other than the appellant, who does not appear to have prima facie any interest in the said lands. The lands of the remaining Khatians, however, as appear from the records of right referred to above, have been recorded in the name of the appellant in possession of the said lands, as a co-sharer.
